title: 第15章 唯心武道收录形意六合拳第16章 店大欺客挽回雕师名声
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
咔咔咔——
好似金属零件碰撞摩擦的声音，机关心脏在血液奔腾之间，一张一缩！
密麻的鲁班锁构铸而成的神工之心上，又开启一格锁。
第三格鲁班锁！
李浪心绪激荡起来，眼眸明亮璀璨。
随着神工之心震动。
霎时，李浪便看到，自己手中攥握的《九曲鳞刻》的秘籍，以极快的速度翻页，一个个文字，好似从其中跃然而起，钻入他的脑海。
整本书册翻阅完毕后，竟像是燃烧起来般，跳动的火光吞没了书籍。
宛如化作飞灰，被烧了个干净。
最后，溢散出白色清气，如蛟龙出海，顺着李浪手臂缠绕蜿蜒，尽数被开启的第三个鲁班锁汲取吞没！
嗡——
一阵嗡吟，似从耳畔传来。
静谧的雪花安安静静的飘零落下，覆阖在他乌黑的发丝之上，斑斑点点。
李浪眼珠子微微一动，手中的书籍已然消失不见，意念一动，清气自掌间溢散，书籍重新出现。
这不是先前他感悟的九曲鳞刻，而是完整的九曲鳞刻雕工技艺书籍。
彻底完成收录！
胸腔中，神工之心怦然扩张收缩间。
眼前好似浮现出一个白色清气所化的“小人”
，正在不断的挥舞着刻刀，那小人的模样，竟是有几分像“叶大师”
而随着“叶大师”

刻刀舞动，修炼“九曲鳞刻”
，李浪脑海中关于这门技艺的理解与修炼，仿佛在同步水涨船高般！
那是叶大师记录在书籍之上的，关于九曲鳞刻技艺的心得与体会！
豁然睁开眼，李浪呼吸微微急促。
哗啦一声，藏于袖中的刻刀，顿时滑出，被五指攥握，一股仿佛挥舞过成百上千次的熟稔感觉，于心底油然而生。
嗡——
刀光乍现，一片飘零白雪，于半空中一阵扭曲，继而便被刀光丝滑的一分为二。
力度、速度，都有了全面的暴增！
手指肌肉轻轻拉扯弹抖，继而刻刀于指尖旋转环绕，刀光似绚烂银花。
“九曲鳞刻，既是雕工技艺，亦是……杀人技！”
啪！
五指攥握，刻刀紧握手中。
猛地于身前划过，留下慢慢消散的白色刀芒。
李浪目光灼灼。
content_en:
Kakaka——
It's like the sound of metal parts colliding and rubbing. The heart of the machine is opening and contracting as the blood rushes!
Another lock is opened on the magical heart made of dense Luban locks.
The third Gruban lock!
Li Lang's mind was agitated and his eyes were bright and bright.
Vibrate with the heart of divine craftsmanship.
In an instant, Li Lang saw that the secret book of "Nine Curved Scales" he was holding in his hand was turning the pages at an extremely fast speed, and each text seemed to jump out of it and penetrate into his mind.
After flipping through the entire book, it seemed as if it was on fire, and the jumping flames engulfed the book.
It was like turning into flying ashes and being burned clean.
Finally, white clear air overflowed, like a dragon emerging from the sea, winding and winding along Li Lang's arms, and was absorbed and swallowed up by the third Luban Lock that was opened!
Buzz——
A buzzing sound seemed to come from my ears.
The quiet snowflakes fell quietly, covering his black hair in spots.
Li Lang's eyes moved slightly, and the book in his hand had disappeared. With a thought, the pure air overflowed from his palm, and the book reappeared.
This is not the nine-curved scale carving that he had previously comprehended, but a complete book on the nine-curved scale carving craftsmanship.
The collection is completely completed!
In the chest, the divine heart was expanding and contracting.
There seemed to be a "little man" transformed into white pure air before his eyes.
, is waving the carving knife constantly, the villain looks a bit like "Master Ye"
And with "Master Ye"
Dance the carving knife and practice "Nine-curved Scale Carving"
, Li Lang's understanding and practice of this skill seemed to rise at the same time!
That is what Master Ye recorded in the book, his thoughts and experiences about the Nine-curved scale carving technique!
Li Lang suddenly opened his eyes, breathing slightly quickly.
With a clatter, the carving knife hidden in the sleeve suddenly slipped out and was grasped by the five fingers. A familiar feeling as if it had been wielded hundreds of thousands of times arose in my heart.
Buzz——
The sword light suddenly appeared, and a piece of white snow twisted in mid-air, and then was divided into two by the sword light.
The intensity and speed have all increased dramatically!
The finger muscles gently pulled and flicked, and then the carving knife rotated around the fingertips, and the knife's light was like a gorgeous silver flower.
"Nine-curved scale carving is not only a carving skill, but also... a killing skill!"
Snap!
The five fingers are clenched, and the carving knife is tightly held in the hand.
It suddenly passed in front of him, leaving behind a white sword light that slowly dissipated.
Li Lang's eyes were burning.
